upload.url_placeholder: Paste an image link to rehost

settings.title: Elysia settings
settings.intro: Limits and image processing applied to every upload. A value of 0 disables that check. Changes apply immediately, no restart needed.
settings.disabled_reason: Select a default target format to enable this.

errors.max_file_size_required: Required: uploads need a byte ceiling.
errors.max_dimension_required: Required when a target format is set, or when thumbnails are enabled.

max_file_size.label: Maximum file size (bytes)
max_file_size.help: Reject uploads larger than this. 0 means no limit.

max_width.label: Maximum width (pixels)
max_width.help: Reject images wider than this. 0 means no limit. Required when a target format is set (it bounds server-side decoding).

max_height.label: Maximum height (pixels)
max_height.help: Reject images taller than this. 0 means no limit. Required when a target format is set (it bounds server-side decoding).

target_format.label: Default convert uploads to
target_format.help: Re-encode every upload to this format by default. 'Store as-is' turns off all processing (resize, conversion and target size below).

allow_overriding_file_format.label: Allow overriding the file format
allow_overriding_file_format.help: Let an upload pick its own output format. When off, the default above is always used. Enabling this requires the maximum width and height above (overrides can trigger server-side decoding).

target_width.label: Resize to fit width (pixels)
target_width.help: Shrink images to fit within this width, keeping aspect ratio. 0 means no resize; images are never upscaled.

target_height.label: Resize to fit height (pixels)
target_height.help: Shrink images to fit within this height, keeping aspect ratio. 0 means no resize; images are never upscaled.

target_file_size.label: Target file size (bytes)
target_file_size.help: If a processed image is still larger than this, lossy-compress it down to fit. 0 means off.

default_compression.label: Default compression quality (1-100)
default_compression.help: Lossy quality applied when an upload does not request one. 0 means lossless by default.

allow_overriding_compression.label: Allow overriding compression
allow_overriding_compression.help: Let an upload request its own compression quality. When off, the default above is always used.
allow_overriding_compression.forced_help: Required: AVIF and JPEG have no lossless mode, so with no default compression an upload must set its own quality.

strip_exif_by_default.label: Strip EXIF by default
strip_exif_by_default.help: Remove metadata such as camera model, GPS location and timestamps from uploads that do not request otherwise.

allow_overriding_strip_exif.label: Allow overriding metadata stripping
allow_overriding_strip_exif.help: Let an upload choose whether to strip its own metadata. When off, the default above is always used.

settings.thumbnails_intro: A smaller preview served from /t/ instead of /i/. Enabled when a width or height is set. Not overridable per upload; images already within the box are served unchanged.

thumbnail_width.label: Thumbnail width (pixels)
thumbnail_width.help: Shrink the thumbnail to fit within this width, keeping aspect ratio. 0 means unconstrained on this axis.

thumbnail_height.label: Thumbnail height (pixels)
thumbnail_height.help: Shrink the thumbnail to fit within this height, keeping aspect ratio. 0 means unconstrained on this axis.

thumbnail_quality.label: Thumbnail quality (1-100)
thumbnail_quality.help: Lossy WebP quality for generated thumbnails.
